gloss: to adapt; to adjust; to acclimate

definitions.gloss: to adapt; to adjust; to acclimate
definitions.explanation: To change oneself or one's behavior in response to new conditions or circumstances. Used for both biological adaptation and personal adjustment to new environments.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{環境|かんきょう}に{適応|てきおう}する。
examples.english: To adapt to a new environment.

examples.japanese: {留学先|りゅうがくさき}の{生活|せいかつ}にようやく{適応|てきおう}できた。
examples.english: I finally managed to adjust to life at my study abroad destination.

examples.japanese: {動物|どうぶつ}は{厳|きび}しい{気候|きこう}にも{適応|てきおう}して{生|い}き{延|の}びてきた。
examples.english: Animals have survived by adapting even to harsh climates.

examples.japanese: {転職|てんしょく}したばかりで、まだ{新|あたら}しい{職場|しょくば}の{文化|ぶんか}に{適応|てきおう}しきれていない。
examples.english: I just changed jobs and haven't fully adjusted to the culture of my new workplace yet.

notes:
Composed of {適|てき} (suitable, fitting) and {応|おう} (respond, apply). Describes the process of becoming suited to new conditions. Can be used for both biological/evolutionary adaptation and everyday personal adjustment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {環境|かんきょう}に{適応|てきおう}する: to adapt to an environment
- {社会|しゃかい}に{適応|てきおう}する: to adjust to society
- {変化|へんか}に{適応|てきおう}する: to adapt to changes
- {適応|てきおう}{能力|のうりょく}: adaptability
- {適応|てきおう}{障害|しょうがい}: adjustment disorder

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {慣|な}れる: to get used to — focuses on becoming accustomed through familiarity; more casual
- {順応|じゅんのう}する: to acclimate — similar meaning but emphasizes conforming to surroundings; slightly more formal
- {対応|たいおう}する: to respond, deal with — focuses on taking action in response to a situation, not changing oneself
